semantics.depends_on: All listed dependencies must be DONE.
semantics.requires_one_of: One DONE branch per group; terminal adapter groups require the exact decisions.json/CTX-013-selected branch.
semantics.conditional_dependencies: Decision-selected features add required DONE dependencies; unresolved relevant decisions block assignment.
semantics.conflict_domains: Advisory exclusive write domains; check actual changed-file ownership too.
semantics.external_inputs_resolved: Explicit coordinator-owned evidence flag, never inferred from elapsed time.
semantics.applicability_decision: selected, pending or deferred; pending/deferred tasks are not automatic assignments.
